description:
The Family Pension scheme under the Haryana Silicosis Board is a welfare initiative aimed at providing financial support to the families of workers who have succumbed to silicosis, a chronic lung disease caused by inhaling silica dust. 

This scheme was launched on January 1, 2018. 

It was introduced to address the plight of families who lose their primary breadwinners due to occupational hazards associated with silica exposure in various industries. 

The primary objective of the Family Pension scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased workers receive a regular source of income to sustain their livelihoods. 

The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to the eligible family members of the deceased worker. 

The specific goal is to offer a financial safety net that helps mitigate the economic impact of losing a family member to silicosis. 

The Family Pension amount is set at ₹10,000 per month. 

This amount is intended to support the family in meeting their basic needs, including food, education, and healthcare. 

The pension is provided until the family member reaches the age of 60 years. 

In the case of multiple eligible family members, the pension is distributed among them as per the guidelines set by the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

Eligibility for the Family Pension scheme is primarily determined by the deceased worker's employment status and the cause of death. 

To qualify, the deceased worker must have been employed in an industry where silica exposure is prevalent. 

The worker must have been a resident of Haryana at the time of death. 

The family members eligible for the pension include the spouse, children, and dependent parents of the deceased worker. 

There are no specific age limits for the spouse or dependent parents. 

However, children must be below the age of 18 years to be eligible for the pension. 

In cases where the children are pursuing higher education, the age limit extends to 21 years. 

The application process for the Family Pension scheme involves several steps. 

Interested family members must obtain the application form from the Haryana Silicosis Board's official website or designated offices. 

The application form must be filled out with accurate details regarding the deceased worker and the family members. 

Required documents include the death certificate of the worker, proof of employment in a silica-related industry, and identity proof of the family members. 

Additionally, the family must provide proof of residence in Haryana. 

Once the application form is completed and documents are gathered, the family must submit them to the nearest office of the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

Applications can also be submitted online through the official portal of the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the designated officials. 

The processing time for the application is typically around 30 days. 

If approved, the pension will commence from the month following the submission of the application. 

The disbursement of the Family Pension is done on a monthly basis. 

Payments are made directly to the bank accounts of the eligible family members. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board is responsible for implementing and managing this scheme. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Haryana. 

For any inquiries or assistance, individuals can contact the Haryana Silicosis Board at their official office. 

The contact details for the board can be found on the Haryana government’s official website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to address occupational health issues and provide support to affected families. 

As of 2023, the Haryana Silicosis Board has reported that over 1,000 families have benefited from the Family Pension scheme since its inception. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹5 crore for the scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This funding is aimed at ensuring the sustainability of the pension payments and expanding outreach to more families in need. 

The Family Pension scheme is a crucial step towards recognizing the sacrifices made by workers in hazardous industries. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the welfare of workers and their families. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of occupational safety and health regulations in the workplace. 

By providing financial assistance, the Haryana government aims to reduce the economic burden on families affected by silicosis. 

The initiative has received positive feedback from various stakeholders, including labor unions and health organizations. 

These groups have highlighted the need for continued support and awareness regarding occupational health risks. 

The Family Pension scheme is expected to evolve over time, with potential enhancements based on feedback from beneficiaries. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board is also working on awareness campaigns to educate workers about the risks of silica exposure. 

These campaigns aim to prevent silicosis and promote safer working conditions in industries where silica dust is prevalent. 

In conclusion, the Family Pension scheme under the Haryana Silicosis Board is a vital welfare initiative. 

It provides essential financial support to families who have lost their loved ones to silicosis. 

With a monthly pension of ₹10,000, the scheme aims to ensure that these families can maintain a basic standard of living. 

The application process is straightforward, with clear eligibility criteria and necessary documentation outlined. 

The commitment of the Haryana government to support affected families through this scheme is commendable. 

It reflects a broader understanding of the need for occupational health and safety in the workforce. 

As the scheme continues to operate, it is expected to make a significant impact on the lives of many families across Haryana.
